description: This file provides platform-specific implementation for managing non-volatile storage settings on ESP32 hardware using the ESP-IDF NVS (Non-Volatile Storage) API. It includes functions to get and set configuration values persisted in the device's flash memory.

methods.name: int lws_settings_plat_get(lws_settings_instance_t * si,const char * name,uint8_t * dest,size_t * max_actual)
methods.description: Retrieves a blob of data associated with a given name from the specified partition in the NVS storage.

methods.name: int lws_settings_plat_set(lws_settings_instance_t * si,const char * name,const uint8_t * src,size_t len)
methods.description: Stores a blob of data associated with a given name into the specified partition in the NVS storage.

ctags.name: lws_settings_plat_set
ctags.signature: (lws_settings_instance_t * si,const char * name,const uint8_t * src,size_t len)
